messages:
maria g: Heads up — opened PR #4523 to change Terraform for the GPU pool autoscale (min=1 -> max=8) in eu-west-1 dedicated. CI passed but GitOps preflight/Conftest flagged a policy 'no-burst-autoscale'. We're in the infra freeze window until Fri 18:00 PT. Need guidance on approval/exception process and whether a canary rollout is required. PR: https://git.redwood/ml-infra/pull/4523

sanjay r: What's the expected outage risk if we do this? Also any rough cost delta for going from 1->8?

izzy p: Risk is low for availability (autoscale adds capacity), main concerns are cost spikes and scheduling noise for other tenants in eu-west-1. If autoscale kicks to 8 on sustained load it could push us over the reserved capacity. Recommend limiting to 4 for a canary and adding a cooldown.

cost-ops: We need a quick estimate. 1 GPU ~= $2.8/hr for that instance family in eu-west-1. Worst-case extra = 7 * $2.8/hr = ~$19.6/hr -> ~$470/day if sustained. Not huge for short bursts but could add up. Add budget alert in the PR description.

deploy-bot: gitops preflight failed: OPA/Conftest policy violation:
```
fail - policy/no-burst-autoscale.rego: deny - autoscale.max > 4 for pool "gpu-pool-eu-west-1"

Resource: module.pool.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu_pool
Attribute: autoscale.max = 8
Message: "autoscale max exceeds allowed burst limit during freeze windows"
```

maria g: Conftest local output (ran `conftest test -p infra/policies terraform/plan.json`):
```
FAIL - 1 policy violation
- policy/no-burst-autoscale.rego: deny - autoscale.max > allowed_max
```
I'm proposing two options: 1) narrow exception to a canary: max=4 + cooldown=300s, label PR with `infra-exception` and require 2 approvers (eng-sre + cost-ops), or 2) full exception to max=8 but only after freeze ends. Thoughts?

sanjay r: Per change approval guardrails we need: - explicit approval from eng-sre (oncall) and finance/cost-ops - PR label `infra-exception` - a runtime canary for 48h if >4. During freeze, we should avoid full 8. I can +1 for the canary change to max=4.

izzy p: I can review and +1 the canary path. Please update the module to include `scaling_cooldown = 300` and add Terraform plan output to the PR. Also add a rollout automation note: GitOps will sync canary pool to a subset of nodes tagged `canary=true`.

maria g: Updated PR: changed max -> 4, added cooldown, added cost calc and `infra-exception` label. Requested reviewers: @izzy p, @sanjay r, @cost-ops. Will hold full-8 proposal until after freeze. Link: https://git.redwood/ml-infra/pull/4523

oncall-bot: @on-call (eng-sre) notified for review (policy: change > 2 GPUs in dedicated pool).

cost-ops: Thanks — will review the cost calc and post a budget alert rule. If the canary stays below 3 for 48h we can consider a gradual raise later.

maria g: Thanks all — proceeding with the canary patch. If anyone sees regressions ping me here and I'll roll back. :thumbsup:
